agents.answer:
I submitted the pizza order, and httpbin accepted it. The response page echoed back these fields:

- **Customer name:** Ada Lovelace
- **Telephone:** 555-0100
- **Email:** ada@example.com
- **Size:** large
- **Toppings:** bacon and cheese (the form's value for Extra Cheese)
- **Delivery time:** 19:45
- **Delivery instructions:** Ring twice

The tab I worked in (t3) is still open on `https://httpbin.org/post`. Other agents navigated my first two tabs, t1 and t2, to other sites while I worked. I left those alone and moved to a fresh tab with tab pinning on.

S=task-4d60840b1713; B="agent-browser --session $S"; $B fill @e112 "Ada Lovelace"; $B fill @e113 "555-0100"; $B fill @e114 "ada@example.com"; $B check @e117; $B check @e118; $B check @e119; $B fill @e122 "Ring twice"; $B eval 'const t=document.querySelector("input[type=time]"); t.value="19:45"; t.dispatchEvent(new Event("input",{bubbles:true})); t.dispatchEvent(new Event("change",{bubbles:true})); location.href+" "+t.value'; $B get url

The order is complete. The confirmation page says "Thank you for your order!" and "Your order has been dispatched, and will arrive just as fast as the pony can get there!"

- **Login:** I logged in as standard_user.
- **Sort:** I set the sort to "Price (low to high)".
- **Cart:** I added Sauce Labs Backpack ($29.99) and Sauce Labs Bike Light ($9.99).
- **Checkout:** I entered Ada Lovelace, postal code 10001. The item total was $39.98, tax $3.20 and the order total $43.18.

I did all of this in a tab I opened myself. The checkout-complete page, https://www.saucedemo.com/checkout-complete.html, is still open in that tab.
